description: Runs Lerna monorepo commands (list, run, changed, version) and returns structured package information.

action.description: Lerna action to perform: list (list packages), run (run script), changed (list changed packages), version (bump versions, dry-run only)

concurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent tasks (maps to --concurrency)

dryRun.description: Preview without making changes. Always enabled for 'version' action for safety.

scope.description: Package filter pattern (e.g., '@scope/pkg' or 'pkg-*'). Maps to --scope.

script.description: Script name to run (required when action is 'run')

name: lerna
title: lerna
